name: ai-image-editor
description: AI-native image editor — SAM 2 object selection + FLUX.1 Kontext Dev editing on Modal GPUs, React/Fabric.js canvas, Express API. Deploys to Render.

scripts.postinstall: npm run build -w packages/types && npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/canvas
scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/types && npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/canvas && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
